name: s5-symbiont-to-organelle
title: S5 — From symbiont to organelle: when does integration become heritable?
concept: Inheritance and evolutionary individuality made operational as the fidelity of vertical transmission across a lineage tree. A chemical phenotype inherited at fission via a module-specific mechanism (template Eigen ratchet, compositional GARD, or a non-heritable control), tracked over many generations — stable heritable integration vs collapse.
question: Which routes to inheritance lead to stable vertical transmission and a persistent lineage? Distinguish mere within-host survival from high-fidelity vertical transmission over many generations.
hypothesis: Stable heritable integration requires high-fidelity vertical transmission: only above the Eigen error threshold does the inherited phenotype persist with function across generations. Below threshold (low fidelity) the lineage collapses; without an inheritance mechanism (non-heritable) there is no vertical transmission at all.
claim: Integration becomes heritable and coordinated — a new evolutionary individual emerges — only when vertical-transmission fidelity crosses the Eigen error threshold, after which the inherited phenotype persists with function across generations. Below threshold (low-fidelity template) the lineage hits the error catastrophe and collapses; a non-heritable mechanism transmits nothing.

behavior_tests.name: heritable-integration-stable
behavior_tests.description: Vertical-transmission fidelity (heritability of the chemical phenotype across the lineage tree) stays high across many generations — only then does the lineage persist with function. The threshold discriminates high-fidelity inheritance from the Eigen-collapse and non-heritable controls.

provenance.note: Calibrated (module=template, per_site_fidelity=0.99, 60 steps): heritability settles to 0.989 (PASS; functional fraction 1.0, population 220, lineage depth 60). Two failure routes fall below 0.95 — a low-fidelity template (per_site_fidelity=0.80, the `low-fidelity-control` variant) hits the Eigen error catastrophe (heritability 0.799, functional fraction 0.0, population 0), and the non-heritable control reads 0.106.

findings.statement: Calibrated (60 generations): a high-fidelity template lineage (per_site_fidelity=0.99) reaches heritability 0.989 and persists with full function (population 220) — stable heritable integration, a new evolutionary individual. Two well-characterized failure routes: a low-fidelity template (0.80) hits the Eigen error catastrophe and collapses (heritability 0.799, population 0), and a non-heritable mechanism transmits nothing (heritability 0.106). Heritable integration emerges only above the fidelity threshold. Direct in-process run.

literature_anchors.expectation: FECA-LECA transition frames where a new eukaryotic individual emerges.

baseline.name: baseline
baseline.note: First-fidelity arm: reuses the og-06 heredity-lineage comparison. settled herd/heritability is the vertical-transmission-fidelity gate. The full population-genetics model coupled to agent-based host/symbiont division with stochastic partitioning + gene-loss / rescue is the next-fidelity arm.
